**Legal compliance cannot be determined from this evidence alone.** No tree-cover loss event of at least 0.5 ha was detected on the property between 2021 and 2025. Smaller losses totaling 0.4 ha were recorded in 2021, and the data may miss other small or narrow changes.

The evidence also records tree-cover loss before the 2020 baseline, but does not establish whether any loss was legal or whether the property meets applicable forest regulations. A legal assessment would require the relevant jurisdiction’s rules and additional documentation.
